title: Nonconventional ergodic averages and nilmanifolds
relevant_concepts: characteristic factors of multiple ergodic averages
PET induction / van der Corput on nilsequences
notes: Ann. of Math. 161 (2005), 397-488. Characteristic-factor arguments on nilmanifolds internally use van der Corput differencing (PET). Cited by docs/problems/juggler_nil_pet_reentry.md and docs/problems/juggler_rate_free_floor_hardy.md: the first PET difference of the Juggler Heisenberg lift, after Mal'cev reduction, re-expands the floor-removal correction into the amplitude-product A{ΔB} of GG species. The paper supplies the induction schema, not a theorem about floor-Hardy entries.
